Package com.simpfi.object

Class TrafficStatistics

java.lang.Object
com.simpfi.object.TrafficStatistics
public class TrafficStatistics extends Object
Computes statistics about average speed, vehicle density, travel times, and congestion hotspots.

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(int currentStep)
      Updates the traffic statistics for the current simulation step. This method updates vehicle speeds, edge densities, and tracks travel times for vehicles exiting the network.
      Parameters:
      currentStep - the current simulation step

    • getAverageSpeed

      public double getAverageSpeed()
      Computes the average speed of all active vehicles.
      Returns:
      the average speed, or 0.0 if no vehicles are active

      public List<String> getCongestedEdges(double speedThreshold)
      Identifies edges that are considered congested based on a speed threshold.

    • getTopCongestionHostspots

      public String getTopCongestionHostspots(int k)
      Returns a string representing the top K congestion hotspots sorted by vehicle count.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a comma-separated string of edge IDs and their vehicle counts
